title: SQL Injection Prevention with SQLAlchemy — Companion Code
title_es: Prevencion de inyeccion SQL con SQLAlchemy — Codigo complementario
description: Runnable SQLAlchemy examples: vulnerable f-string query vs text() bound params, ORM select, dynamic filters, ORDER BY whitelists, and LIKE wildcard escaping against in-memory SQLite.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de SQLAlchemy: query vulnerable con f-strings vs text() con parametros vinculados, select ORM, filtros dinamicos, whitelists de ORDER BY y escape de wildcards LIKE contra SQLite en memoria.
